sample.query: 为什么注意力点积要除以sqrt(d_k)？

provenance.basis: Source-checked paraphrases, not a full PDF benchmark

documents.text: Transformer attention computes softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))V. Scaling the dot products counteracts small softmax gradients at large key dimensions.
The position-wise Transformer feed-forward layer uses two affine transformations separated by ReLU; the inner width is 2048 for the base configuration.
Transformer adds sinusoidal positional signals to token embeddings. Learned positional embeddings gave similar development results in the comparison.
The Transformer used WMT 2014 English-German data with approximately 4.5 million sentence pairs, and English-French with 36 million pairs.
For English-German translation, Transformer big achieved 28.4 BLEU on newstest2014. This is a translation metric, not classification accuracy.
The Transformer head-count ablation found one head worse than the best setting by 0.9 BLEU; excessive heads also reduced quality.
LoRA adapts pretrained models by training low-rank decomposition matrices while keeping the original model weights fixed.
For GPT-3 175B compared with Adam full fine-tuning, LoRA reports 10,000-fold fewer trainable parameters and threefold lower GPU memory requirements.
Unlike adapters, LoRA reports no added inference latency. The experiments include RoBERTa, DeBERTa, GPT-2 and GPT-3.

provenance.basis: Source-checked paraphrases, not a full PDF benchmark

documents.text: Transformer attention computes softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))V. Scaling the dot products counteracts small softmax gradients at large key dimensions.
The position-wise Transformer feed-forward layer uses two affine transformations separated by ReLU; the inner width is 2048 for the base configuration.
Transformer adds sinusoidal positional signals to token embeddings. Learned positional embeddings gave similar development results in the comparison.
The Transformer used WMT 2014 English-German data with approximately 4.5 million sentence pairs, and English-French with 36 million pairs.
For English-German translation, Transformer big achieved 28.4 BLEU on newstest2014. This is a translation metric, not classification accuracy.
The Transformer head-count ablation found one head worse than the best setting by 0.9 BLEU; excessive heads also reduced quality.
LoRA adapts pretrained models by training low-rank decomposition matrices while keeping the original model weights fixed.
For GPT-3 175B compared with Adam full fine-tuning, LoRA reports 10,000-fold fewer trainable parameters and threefold lower GPU memory requirements.
Unlike adapters, LoRA reports no added inference latency. The experiments include RoBERTa, DeBERTa, GPT-2 and GPT-3.
